title: 3243. Shortest Distance After Road Addition Queries I

examples.explanation: After the addition of the road from 2 to 4, the length of the shortest path from 0 to 4 is 3. After the addition of the road from 0 to 2, the length of the shortest path from 0 to 4 is 2. After the addition of the road from 0 to 4, the length of the shortest path from 0 to 4 is 1.
After the addition of the road from 0 to 3, the length of the shortest path from 0 to 3 is 1. After the addition of the road from 0 to 2, the length of the shortest path remains 1.
